arguments.sql:
WITH patient_counts AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, COUNT(l.Date) AS test_dates
    FROM main.Patient AS p
    LEFT JOIN main.Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
      AND p.ID NOT IN (
          SELECT e.ID
          FROM main.Examination AS e
          WHERE e.ID IS NOT NULL
      )
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
)
SELECT SEX, COUNT(*) AS patients, SUM(test_dates > 0) AS patients_with_dates, SUM(test_dates) AS total_dates FROM patient_counts GROUP BY SEX;

WITH patient_counts AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, COUNT(l.Date) AS test_dates
    FROM main.Patient AS p
    LEFT JOIN main.Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
      AND p.ID NOT IN (
          SELECT e.ID
          FROM main.Examination AS e
          WHERE e.ID IS NOT NULL
      )
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN test_dates END), 2) AS F,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN test_dates END), 2) AS M
FROM patient_counts
LIMIT 1
